title: fix(plugin-charts): ObjectChart decides its missing-category-axis refusal before it fetches, so a refused chart reads nothing (objectui#12061)
body:
Fixes #12061
Clause-②: no

`ObjectChart` now decides its missing-category-axis refusal (objectui#8168, `chart-missing-category-axis`) before it fetches, so a chart that refuses reads nothing. This is the shape objectui#7390 gave `ObjectGallery`: decide the binding first, then fetch. There is no `$top` cap, and the refusal's code, `role="alert"` and wording are unchanged.

Written by a dispatched os-dev run of the `domain:ui#3` seat, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`. Claim `6085092086`, triage direction `6082360035`. Base: `main` at `8a55f0cc`, which carries PR objectui#12060.

## What changes

- **`packages/plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.tsx`.** The refusal's predicate is one value, `refusesMissingCategoryAxis` (`drawsFetchedObjectRows && !resolveChartCategoryField(schema)`). It is declared beside `fetchesForItself`, and three readers use it:
  - the render-time refusal return, which used to compute the same expression inline;
  - `fetchesForItself`, so the fetch effect does not call `fetchData` for a refused chart;
  - the `useDataInvalidation` key, which reads `fetchesForItself`, so a refused chart is not subscribed and a write to its object does not start a read.

  `hasAuthoredRows` and `drawsFetchedObjectRows` move up beside the gate unchanged, because the fetch effect sits above where they were declared. `groupByCategoryKey` still reads `drawsFetchedObjectRows`.
- **The fetch effect lists `fetchesForItself`.** A spec `xAxis: { field }` added later, for example in a designer preview, moves none of the effect's other dependencies. Without this, a chart refused at mount would never fetch once its category was declared. Listing it also makes the dependency list exhaustive, so its `eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` directive was reported unused (an error) and is removed.
- **New pin:** `ObjectChart.refuseBeforeFetch-12061.test.tsx`. See below.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/12061-chart-refuse-before-fetch.md`, `patch` on `@object-ui/plugin-charts`.

No export, prop, type or language-pack key changes.

## The dispatch's mechanism hypotheses, measured

1. **Where the decision was made.** The refusal was the render-time return `if (drawsFetchedObjectRows && !resolveChartCategoryField(schema))`. The fetch effect was gated only by `fetchesForItself`, which did not read that predicate. Both now read `refusesMissingCategoryAxis`, the single copy of the rule.
2. **The other fetch paths, each read against a refused node:**
   - `ds.aggregate` (the aggregate leg of `runAggregate`). The probe node does not reach it, because it has no `aggregate`. A refused node that carries a measure and no `groupBy` does reach it, and was measured issuing `aggregate` once on `main`. It is the same object-bound query, inside the same `fetchData`, behind the same gate. The ruling says a chart that will refuse reads nothing, so it is gated too, with no second copy of the rule.
   - The `compareTo` comparison window runs `runAggregate` a second time inside `fetchData`. It is behind the same gate and pinned.
   - The reference-label `find` in `resolveGroupByLabels`, and `ds.getObjectSchema`, run only when `groupByField` resolves (`aggregateGroupByKey(...) || schema.xAxisKey`). An unbound node does not resolve it: `getObjectSchema` was called 0 times on `main`, and is called 0 times now.
   - The option-colour metadata probe (`/api/v1/meta/object/...`) already returns before fetching when `resolveChartCategoryField` answers nothing. The global `fetch` was called 0 times for the probe node, before and after. It is unchanged.
   - The dataset path (`queryDataset`, `/api/v1/meta/dataset/...`) is never refused, and is untouched.
   - The invalidation subscription is not a read in itself, but on `main` it re-ran `find` for a refused chart on every write to the object: 2 `find` calls after one `notifyDataChanged`. It is now unsubscribed.
3. **The loading state.** The refusal return sits above the `loading` branch in render order. The first paint is the refusal: right after the synchronous `render`, the refusal is present and `chart-loading` is absent, both on `main` and now. The `useState` initializer still starts `loading` as true for this node, which cannot show, and the effect's non-fetching branch now clears it.

## The pins and the probe reading

`ObjectChart.refuseBeforeFetch-12061.test.tsx`, through the real `ObjectChart`, with `ChartRenderer` stubbed:

| Case | `main` at `8a55f0cc` | This branch |
|---|---|---|
| Round-15 probe node `{ objectName: 'task', chartType: 'bar', filter: [] }`: `find` / `aggregate` / `getObjectSchema` / metadata `fetch`, refusal on the first paint | `find` x1 (RED) | 0 / 0 / 0 / 0, refusal drawn |
| Measure with no `groupBy` | `aggregate` x1 (RED) | 0 reads, refusal drawn |
| `compareTo` on a refused chart | not run on `main`; RED under ablation A | 0 reads |
| A write to the object after mount | `find` x2 (RED) | 0 reads |
| Control: category on `xAxisKey` | `find` x1, `('task', { $filter: [] })` | identical |
| Control: category on `aggregate.groupBy` | `aggregate` x1, same arguments | identical |
| Refused at mount, then a spec `xAxis` is added | not run on `main`; RED under ablations A and B | `find` x1 after the category arrives |

The pre-fix run, against unmodified `ObjectChart.tsx`, reproduces the card's probe: `Tests 3 failed | 2 passed (5)`. The file then held the probe, measure, write and two control cases; the `compareTo` and transition cases were added after the fix.

## Reverse verification

Predictions were written before each run. Each mutation went through `ablation-replace` in WRAP mode, with the restore proven by blob hash plus an empty `git diff HEAD`. The pin imports `./ObjectChart` relatively, so the mutated source is what runs, and no build is involved.

- **A: put the fetch back ahead of the decision.** The anchor `!schema.data && !refusesMissingCategoryAxis;` becomes `!schema.data;`. Predicted: 5 red in the new file, the 2 bound controls green, and all 23 in the 8168 file green. Observed: `Tests 5 failed | 25 passed (30)`, the 5 named reds exactly. Run at `2a98113fe`, and again at `3c953d7de` with the same result. Restore: blob `9bdf6c1ff5aa` equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **B: drop the gate from the fetch effect's dependency list.** Predicted: only the refused-then-`xAxis` case goes red. Observed: `Tests 1 failed | 6 passed (7)`, that case. Restore proven the same way.

The 9 skips are the pre-existing `describe.runIf(DRIVEN)` timezone pins (objectui#10866).

## Acceptance notes

- Docs: no page under `content/docs/` and no package README describes the refusal's fetch behaviour, so no docs change.
- Noted, not filed (an inference from reading the code, with no measured producer; carrier: none). The `runAggregate` comment says a missing `groupBy` column means the chart "is already refused" by the 8168 screen. That holds only when nothing else names a category. A node with `aggregate: { field, function }` and an `xAxisKey` is not refused, and still sends `groupBy: undefined` to `ds.aggregate`. `ChartAggregate` requires `groupBy`, so the authoring door refuses that document, and no producer that composes it was found.
